en-US.DESC_OVERLAY_ENABLED: Master switch for every overlay HUD — panels, progress bar, combo and judgement.
en-US.DESC_OVERLAY_FPS_SMOOTH: How long the FPS counter holds each value before updating. 0 = every frame; higher makes the number tick more slowly and steadily.
en-US.DESC_OVERLAY_POP: Slide every overlay in from the edge of the screen when a run starts, and back out when you die or clear.
en-US.OVERLAY_POP_EXIT: Slide Out on Death or Clear
en-US.DESC_OVERLAY_POP_EXIT: Slide the overlays back off screen when the run ends. Turn this off to leave them on screen.
